title: Garmin Run Marathon Series Malaysia 2026 Review: Putrajaya's Sold-Out Tech-Brand Race
seo_title: Garmin Run Marathon Series Malaysia 2026 Review | Putrajaya
meta_description: The 2026 Garmin Run Marathon Series Malaysia: November 1 at Putrajaya. 21K and 10K — now sold out. Garmin's Malaysian marathon-series entry reviewed.
dek: Set for 1 November 2026 at Putrajaya, this Garmin-branded marathon series event offers 21K and 10K distances — and it's already sold out. A tech-brand Malaysian race at the country's most photogenic government precinct.
verdict: The 2026 Garmin Run Marathon Series Malaysia is notable for what it says about demand: it's sold out. A Garmin-branded half marathon and 10K in Putrajaya — Malaysia's grand administrative capital with its pink mosque, wide ceremonial boulevards, and lakeside setting — this is part of Garmin's growing Asia run-series portfolio. SCORE Experience handles the production. If you didn't get in, watch for cancellations or target the 2027 edition. For those who did secure a spot: expect Garmin's signature tech touches (GPS-art finisher data, likely), premium race merchandise, and a well-produced event at one of Malaysia's most photogenic venues.

sections.heading: Sold Out: A Sign of Demand
paragraphs: The fact that this race is already sold out — for a November 2026 date — speaks to Garmin's pull in the Malaysian running community. [1] Putrajaya's wide, flat boulevards and iconic architecture (Putra Mosque, Perdana Putra, the lakefront) provide a world-class running backdrop.
